newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE to try to confront the 4,660 level.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE to try to confront the 4,660 level.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may go up to around 4,660 on Monday, technical analaysts said.

The frantic tempo last week -- when the index shot up 175 points -- shows no signs of abating just yet and the fear of being underweight in the market will be enough to persuade investors keep buying shares which will keep the market buoyant, they added.

The FTSE may edge down a little as investors test just how secure the region around 4,630 is. But if this level holds it could then square up for a confrontation of 4,660. By 0726 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 12.3 at 4,643.2.

A chart of the FTSE over the past week shows it traced out the familiar pattern of two discrete moves up and from Elliott wave theory a third move up is now due before a little correction takes place.

Last week's winning sectors, which included the banks and insurers, may now become a little subdued as interest switches to the alcoholic beverages sector following this morning's news of the merger of Guinness and Grand Metropolitan to form a new company called GMG Brands.
This switching of interest between sectors will prevent the FTSE from racing ahead, analysts said.
